summary: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose a press release containing preliminary financial data as of May 31, 2026, and a monthly dividend declaration of $0.12 per common share. The filing is a routine periodic update on book value, portfolio, liquidity, and leverage, with no M&A, restructuring, or special-situation event. The registrar is the issuer providing standard operational and financial disclosures. As this is a typical monthly dividend and financial update, it does not constitute a special situation. No terms, advisors, or structural mechanics apply. Watch for future earnings calls for performance trends.
